resources.string: Plug a phone into the USB port
Airplane mode is on, so Bluetooth and Wi-Fi are off.
Bluetooth is off. CarPlay finds your iPhone over Bluetooth.
Wi-Fi is off. Wireless CarPlay runs over Wi-Fi.
No iPhone found. Unlock it and check that its Bluetooth and Wi-Fi are on.
Road, wind and engine noise is taken out of the cabin microphone before your voice goes to the phone.
Record 20 s of this call\'s mic
For tuning: during a call, tap to record the mic before and after echo cancellation and noise suppression, and the phone\'s sound, for 20 s. Nothing records unless you tap.
No call or Siri running: start a CarPlay call first, then tap.
A check is already running or being saved.
● RECORDING the call mic: %1$d s left
The cabin mic is being saved for %1$d s, for tuning.
Voice recognition: the cabin mic on the speech-recognition route
Unprocessed: the cabin mic with no head unit effects (default)
Tap, then talk normally for 12 s. Each mic source records 3 s in turn and shows its level. Each recording is saved in Riposte/MicProbe.
A call or Siri is using the mic. End it, then tap again.
Vendor voice processing: the head unit\'s echo and noise filter (the old path)
Echo cancellation: keeps the phone\'s sound out of your mic, so the other person does not hear themselves
Echo canceller unavailable on this device: the mic goes out without it
Noise suppression for CarPlay (Siri and calls)
Automatic: the standard model until a car-tuned one beats it on this car\'s own road noise
Car-tuned model %1$s active, trained on this car\'s road noise
Car-tuned model %1$s active, %2$s downloaded for the next call
Car-tuned model %1$s downloaded, in use from the next call
No car-tuned model downloaded yet: the standard model runs until one arrives
Noise suppressor unavailable on this device: the mic goes out unprocessed
Changes apply at once, even during a call: ask the person you are talking to which sounds clearer. Light keeps more of the cabin, Strong removes the most.
